focuses.name: Rush the Pass
focuses.bestUse: Ready food is aging or several tickets are close to completion.
focuses.benefit: Moves near-ready tickets toward handoff first.

focuses.name: Protect the Special
focuses.bestUse: An event or active promotion creates a short demand window.
focuses.benefit: Favors tickets that match the current event or featured dish.

focuses.name: Clear the Queue
focuses.bestUse: Station queues are growing faster than they clear.
focuses.benefit: Favors shorter tickets to reduce visible backlog.
focuses.downside: Premium or longer tickets may wait.

focuses.name: Save Ingredients
focuses.bestUse: A menu ingredient is running short or unavailable.
focuses.benefit: Avoids consuming the scarcest ingredients first.
focuses.downside: Conversion and menu choice can shrink.

focuses.name: Premium First
focuses.bestUse: High-value tables or premium tickets need protection.
focuses.benefit: Favors the highest-margin tickets on the rail.

focuses.name: Recovery Mode
focuses.bestUse: Seated guests are close to abandoning their orders.
focuses.benefit: Favors tickets for the tables at greatest patience risk.
